senses.gloss:
n. (-कृत्)
Cowdung.
E.
गो a cow, and शकृत् ordure.

mfn. sub. (-लः-ला-लं)
A cowhouse.
adj.
Born in a cowhouse.
E.
गो a cow, and शाला a hall.

n. (-र्षं)
1 A kind of Sandal, described as of the colour of brass, and of great fragrance.
2 The head of a cow.
E.
गो a cow, and शीर्ष the head.

m. (-कः)
A plant; also called Droṇapuṣpī.
E.
कन् added to गोशीर्ष.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A tree; also Berbera.
n. (-ङ्गं)
The horn of a cow.
E.
गो, and शृङ्ग a horn.

r. 1st cl. (गोष्ठते)
To assemble, to collect, to heap together.

mn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठं)
1 A cowpen, a fold for cattle, any place where animals are kept.
2 A station of cowherds.
f. (-ष्ठी)
1 An assembly, a meeting.
2 Conversation, discourse, dialogue, dispute.
3 Family connexions, but especially the dependant or junior branches.
4 A dramatic composition in one act.
E.
गो a cow, and ष्ठ from स्था to stay, with क affix; here meaning the place of abiding, or गोष्ठ to assemble, affix अच्.

f. (-का)
A mound or altar in a cowpen.
E.
गोष्ठ, and वेदिका a mound.

mfn. (-श्वः-श्वा-श्वं)
Malignant, censorious, envious: especially applied to a person who stays at home, and slanders his neighbours.
E.
गोष्ठ a cowpen, in the first case used for abode in general, and श्वि to increase, affix ड, who magnifies himself in his own house.
m. (-श्वः)
A horse in a cowpen.
E.
गोष्ठ, and अश्व a horse, the form is irregular.

f. (-मी)
A particular holiday: see गोपाष्टमी.

m. (-ति)
1 The chief person in assembly, a president.
2 The master of a family.
E.
गोष्ठी, and पति master.

n. (-दं)
1 A spot frequented by kine.
2 A measure, as much as a cow's footstep will hold.
3 The mark or impression of a cow's foot.
4 A cow's foot or hoof.
E.
गो a cow, and पद for पाद a foot.

m. (-सः)
1 Gum myrrh.
2 The last watch of the night, early morning or day-break.
E.
गो water, dew, and षो to destroy, to absorb, affix ड.

m. (-ख्यः)
A herdsman, a cowherd.
E.
गो a cow, and सम् prefixed to ख्या to count, affix ड.

n. (-हं)
The inner part of a house, an inner or sleeping room, a bedchamber.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Dawn, day-break.
E.
गो a cow, and सङ्ग meeting, junction; the herd assembling at that time.

m. (-क्षः)
The Gayal, (Bos gavæus.)
E.
गो a cow, and सदृक्ष like, from सदृश with स aff.

m. (-यः)
One who gives a cow.
E.
गो a cow, दा to give, with सम् prefixed, युक् augment, affix अच्.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Produced from or by a cow.
E.
गो and सम्भव born.

m. (-र्गः)
Dawn, day-break.
E.
गो a cow, and सर्ग going forth, the cattle then going forth to pasture.

m. (-वः)
The sacrifice of a cow, one of the grand sacrifices of the Hindus in former times, and not permitted in the present or Kali age: see गोमेध.
E.
गो a cow, and सव sacrifice.

m. (-शः)
Myrrh: see गोस and शश.

m. (-नः)
1 The udder of a cow.
2 A garland consisting of four or of thirty-four strings.
3 A cluster of blossoms, a nosegay, &c.
f. (-ना or नी)
A grape.
E.
गो a cow, and लन a breast, full or clustering like the udder of a cow.

n. (-नं)
A cowpen, a station for cattle.
E.
गो a cow, and स्थान a place; also with कन् added गोस्थानक.

n. (-कं)
See the preceding.

m. (-मी)
1 The master or possessor of herds.
2 A holy man, a religious personage and teacher; in common language, a Gosain.
E.
गो kine, or an organ of sense, and स्वामिन् a lord or master.
